title: Joining Louis Armstrong in 1935
summary: Dating when he joined Armstrong, which sessions he was on, and replacing Harry White.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I didn't think you joined him until '36.
How long do you think you were in the band before you made those records; do you think you were in the band a few months before you made the records?
Oh yeah.
I'm trying to place when you joined Louis. Do you think you joined Louis around Thanksgiving, say of '35?
I think it was, the latter part of '35.
Was it the fall or winter of '35?
I think it was fall.
Where was he working, was he at Carney's Inn?
No.
He was not at Carney's Inn?
No, he wasn't there.
If that's the case, you could conceivably be on some other records.
I was.
I know you were on at least three sessions.
At least three sessions.

Then the thing was when Louie went to make the picture in California, he wasn't recording with his own band, he was recording with Jimmy Dorsey, he was recording with Andy Ione and everybody else, but he wasn't using his own band.
I know you were on at least three different sessions but I think they were all done in the spring of '36.
I don't know, maybe you were on something in '35.
I was on 'Swing That'
Music", "Dinah", I Come From a Musical Family", "Somebody Stole My Bread", "If We Ever Meet Again"; I was on all of these records.
When you came in the band, you took Harry White's place? No. You took--
A little short guy.
Not Archie?
No, Archie was with me for a while; that's right.
Archie came in with you, came in following you. You and Archie were in there together.
Archie and I were both there together for a while.
Harry White--was he in the band with you?
No, I took Harry White's place.
